entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Allow extensions to provide custom variable/field/etc. name suggestions #78996
    Backlog
  • ArgumentOutOfRangeException in CompositeText.RemoveSplitLineBreaksAndEmptySegments #78985
  • CS1673 is inappropriately reported for nameof(this.Xyz) in a lambda/local func in a struct instance member #78983

Closed

  • VB.NET Professional 2022 project properties not showing splash screen in drop down. #78697
    Backlog
  • Remove suppression of VSIXCompatibility1001 #71404
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Merge main #78994
    Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Remove workarounds for the Running Document Table threading issues #78993
  • Update 'use null propagation' to understand more patterns #78992
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [WIP] test signing #78991
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix restore for 'dotnet run app.cs' in IDE #78990
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Fix SubText ctor parameter verification. #78989
    Area-Compilers
  • Inline Method Refactoring - Fix bug for field with multiple declarations #78988
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Test ref safety analysis for extension operators #78987
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Add a source package that can be used to connect to the roslyn build server #78986
    Area-Compilers
  • Allow rename to (optionally) process source generated documents #78984
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Fix locating startup objects #78972
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Second attempt at updating versions #78796
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Delete unused package references #78958
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Use static extension operators regardless of LangVer #78953
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Updated

  • Fix nullable analysis involving extensions and collection expressions #78926
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Take reachability into account when rewriting `await`s in `finally` blocks #78970
    Area-Compilers
  • Keep parse options in the result of `SyntaxFactory.Parse*` methods #78790
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Make synthesized primary constructor baking field return the original parameter as an associated symbol #78982
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
  • Allow LanguageServerProjectSystems to load into more than one workspace #78975
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Resource tracking #78662
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Extensions: bind unconditionally of LangVer #78947
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Remove synchronous rename #78839
    Area-IDE
  • Move tracking of builds to unit-test solution crawler code #78905
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extensions: use specific tracking issues for different areas (second pass) #78971
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Razor assembly redirector #78852
    VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #78976
    Area-Infrastructure
